children: Prasad Sohail, a Director and President, CEO, purchased Common Stock at weighted average prices of $31.40, $31.53 and $32.14 per share on Sept. 1–3, 2026. The total purchase amount reported for the three transactions is $1,767,343. Following the reported purchases, Sohail directly owns 64,000 common shares and indirectly owns 703,190 common shares through entities and family holdings.
